title.en: How can I develop the code myself?

description.en: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Download your repository and open it in Claude Code or Codex. Give the AI assistant your project documents, describe the changes and check the result before publishing."}]}]}
